summary: The source constructs CSR data, copies all inputs to device, selects Width 4/8/16/32 from mean row length, then performs a separate synchronized warmup when iterations are nonzero. Compiled main's counted event-timed loop calls the chosen launcher and increments/compares the runtime count before its backedge; event synchronization follows. Each kernel specialization uses subgroup row assignment and Width-strided CSR products, then reduction and output store; final sm86 SASS bodies for every selectable width are present.
